::: {#def-nffrcistg .theorem}
## NFFRCISTG model

A network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (NFFRCISTG) is a causal model $\mathcal{C}=(\mathcal{M},\mathcal{M}^{(\Gamma)})$ of an NPSEM $\mathcal{M}$, where $\mathcal{M}$ satisfies (1) no contagion, (2) homogeneous network interference with respect to some graph set $\mathcal{H}$, (3) identical structural distributions, and (4) single-world independence.
:::
